create_vertexai_backend: create a VertexAI backend instance with a model name and optional safety settings
run_vertexai_generate: run a VertexAI non-streaming content generation call with text or multimodal input
run_vertexai_generate_stream: run a VertexAI streaming content generation call yielding incremental text chunks
build_vertexai_messages: build VertexAI-formatted messages from OpenAI-style message lists with role and content conversion
build_vertexai_multimodal_input: build VertexAI multimodal input from text with image tokens and base64 image data
